items.title: Show HN: Whami is a daily trivia game that writes its own questions every night
items.contentSnippet:
For my Masters final project I had WHAMI built by offshore developers and it took 2 months.  I recently rebuilt it myself with Claude and I'd like you to give it a try.
10 Questions every day starting at 6am EST, but play anytime you'd like. 2 of the questions are music clips and one is a zoomed photo that slowly pulls back to show the entire image.
The faster you answer, the more points you get and the questions get progressively challenging.
iOS app available here: https://apps.apple.com/us/ap

items.title: Show HN: CircuitPilot – We built a physics engine to auto-route PCBs using LLMs
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN,
We wanted to see if we could build an AI agent that actually designs real, manufacturable PCBs from natural language, rather than just spitting out text.
LLMs are great at logic but terrible at spatial reasoning. So we decoupled them: we use an LLM (OpenAI/Claude/Local) to extract a component manifest and run an IPC-rules check (the "Critic"), and then we pass that to a custom Native Python Engine we wrote from scratch.

items.title: Show HN: Vegetarian Meal Prep and Grocery (100% free)
items.contentSnippet:
My wife and I are vegetarians who meal prep. Grocery lists/shopping are tedious so we fixed it.
VegBatch lets us pick a recipe, scale it to our week, and produce grocery lists for meals + staples. Then we use the PWA as a checklist in the grocery store.
Has all of our 254 recipes, 107 vegan. Free, no ads, no account needed.  If you do create a free account, it will store your history and staples (non recipe related groceries).
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49802139

items.title: Show HN: Numban reports scammers callback number rather than spoofed caller ID
items.contentSnippet:
I get a LOT of scam calls every week and cannot reliably block them because they spoof their caller ID. But they CANNOT spoof the call back number they leave on my voicemail.
So I made Numban - You share the voicemail left by scammers, Numban extracts the call back number they left, looks up the carrier or RespOrg, and files an abuse complaint.
Numban checks the number periodically and when it detects that it has been disconnected, it lets you know that you helped kill a number. There's a leader

items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN, I built Brayer to make mockups for my other SaaS projects. I couldn't get existing tools to do what I wanted, so I started building my own.

items.title: The Creolisation of Recognition
items.contentSnippet: What if our recognition systems are still doing the quiet work of colonization, even when they claim inclusion? Simone Ravaioli of Instructure explores creolization as a generative framework for redesigning how we validate learning across cultural and epistemological borders. Drawing on thinkers like Tyson Yunkaporta and Serge Ravet, this piece challenges education leaders to move beyond Recognition of Prior Learning toward relational protocols that let different knowledge systems meet as equals
